claims.subject: saltmere
claims.statement: Saltmere is a fishing town on the north coast of the Grey Reach.
claims.quote: Saltmere is a fishing town on the north coast of the Grey Reach

claims.subject: gull_tower
claims.statement: The Gull Tower is a white lighthouse that guards the harbor and is older than the town charter.
claims.quote: The harbor is guarded by the Gull Tower, a white lighthouse older than the town charter

claims.subject: salt_lantern
claims.statement: The Salt Lantern is a great lens of green glass made by a glassmaker whose name is forgotten.
claims.quote: a great lens of green glass ground by a glassmaker whose name nobody remembers

claims.subject: salt_lantern
claims.statement: Boats have steered by the Salt Lantern's light for two hundred years.
claims.quote: Boats have steered by its light for two hundred years

claims.subject: odrin_vale
claims.statement: Odrin Vale has kept the Salt Lantern for thirty-one years without missing a night.
claims.quote: He has tended the Salt Lantern for thirty-one years and has never missed a night

claims.subject: odrin_vale
claims.statement: Odrin Vale wears the keys of the tower on a cord around his neck.
claims.quote: he keeps the keys to the tower on a cord around his neck

claims.subject: odrin_vale
claims.statement: Odrin Vale lives at the foot of the tower stairs with a gray cat called Pilot.
claims.quote: He lives in two rooms at the foot of the stairs with a gray cat named Pilot

claims.subject: wren_ashby
claims.statement: Wren Ashby is seventeen and the apprentice of the ferrywoman Tamsin Reed.
claims.quote: Wren Ashby is seventeen and the apprentice of the ferrywoman Tamsin Reed

claims.subject: wren_ashby
claims.statement: Tamsin pays Wren four gulls a week.
claims.quote: Tamsin pays Wren four gulls a week

claims.subject: dunlin
claims.statement: The Dunlin is the small ferry that Wren rows across the harbor every morning.
claims.quote: Wren rows the small ferry Dunlin across the harbor

claims.subject: currency
claims.statement: One gold crown is worth twenty silver gulls.
claims.quote: One gold crown is worth twenty silver gulls

claims.subject: corwen_pike
claims.statement: Corwen Pike is the harbormaster and runs the docks with a ledger and a loud voice.
claims.quote: The harbormaster, Corwen Pike, runs the docks with a ledger and a loud voice

claims.subject: harbor_fund
claims.statement: The harbor fund is kept in an iron chest in the harbormaster's office.
claims.quote: He keeps the harbor fund in an iron chest in his office

claims.subject: corwen_pike
claims.statement: Corwen has hidden from the council that the harbor chest has been almost empty since last spring.
claims.quote: he has not told the town council that the chest has been almost empty since last spring

claims.subject: salt_lantern

claims.quote: the Salt Lantern went dark

claims.subject: odrin_vale

claims.quote: Odrin Vale was found at the foot of the stairs, dazed, with a bruise on his temple

claims.subject: gull_tower
claims.statement: The tower door was locked from the inside when the lens disappeared.

claims.subject: marsh_bridge

claims.quote: the only road out of Saltmere crosses the Marsh Bridge

claims.subject: wren_ashby

claims.quote: Wren steered by the sound of the harbor bell and reached the pier with shaking hands
